environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway, but the API Gateway stage is fronted by a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with a VPC endpoint service configuration. The NLB has a target group pointing to the VPC endpoint for execute-api. Inbound traffic to the NLB is controlled by a Security Group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b3d5a7f9) that permits TCP/443 only from three CIDR ranges: 10.200.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress), 172.16.50.0/24 (office NAT gateway pool), and 192.168.100.0/28 (CI/CD runners). The NLB listener on port 443 has a TLS policy (ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06). DNS for api.acmecorp.com resolves to the NLB's private IP addresses via Route53 private hosted zone associated with the corporate VPC. There is no public DNS record for this endpoint. The API Gateway resource policy additionally denies any request where sourceVpc is not vpc-0e8a3b5c7d9f1a2e4. Note: the CORS header in the Lambda response still references the internal app domain.

config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, no public resolution for api.acmecorp.com
